title: Answer key contradicts the explicit font-color convention
evidence: The instructions require green for plain references such as '=A1', but the golden workbook retains black font on 59 plain-reference formulas. Examples include 'Operating Model + DCF'!C89 '=M20', C117 '=Cover!$D$7', and 'Comps + WACC'!C17 '=F4'. Changing only these 59 fonts to green, while preserving the golden values and all other cells, produces regression ratio 0.9955 and modification ratio 1.0000. The verifier requires regression >=0.998 and consequently awards zero on the sole check, weighted 1. Correct compliance with the stated convention therefore fails grading.
confirmation: In the golden, 'Operating Model + DCF'!C89 (=M20) and C117 (=Cover!$D$7) and 'Comps + WACC'!C17 (=F4) are black (FF000000), not the green the prompt mandates. Recolouring roughly 59 such regression cells gives a ratio below 0.998 and a score of 0.
fix: The 59 black plain references (e.g. 'Operating Model + DCF'!C89 =M20, C117 =Cover!$D$7, 'Comps + WACC'!C17 =F4) are green 006600 in the key. Checked with the real SB2 scorer (font_color mode): new key vs itself 1.0, input plus all key fixes (formulas and colours) 1.0, untouched input 0.0, planted-only fixes (old key) 0.0 (expected).

title: Prompt asks for a full audit (formula logic, hardcodes, calculation errors), but grading only rewards a specific set of recolourings and penalizes any other legitimate fix
evidence: The instruction says: "Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors..." The GT differs from the input in only about 41 font colours plus one value change: the stray 'c' in 'Operating Model + DCF'!S6 is deleted. No formula, value or hardcode in the GT is corrected. The verifier runs in font_color mode, which compares values and colours across 13,281 cells and allows at most 0.2% regression drift. So any real formula or hardcode fix that changes a cached value can push the score to 0. That also covers knock-on changes in dependent cells. The output scope the prompt asks for does not match the scope that is graded.
confirmation: Confirmed: the golden contains no formula or value repair except removing S6 'c' (e.g. R84 =R847-M83 and F28 =F20-F26 are kept). In font_color mode any requested formula fix that changes values counts against the regression cells and fails.
fix: Formula fixes in gt_08_golden.xlsx ('Operating Model + DCF' unless noted; 116 dependent cached values rewritten from the verifier's LibreOffice recalc): EBT row C28:V28 now =EBIT-interest-other (=C20-C23-C26 ..., was =C20-C26 dropping interest; F28 now 52.554, matching 'IS Annual' pretax income); R84 =R83-M83 (was =R847-M83); C90 tax rate 0.3 (was -0.3); I62:L62 Capex =-'Key Stats'!G21..J21 (was 'IS Quarters'!E69:H69 depreciation); 'Revenue Build'!S9:V9 =S35..V35 and S15:V15 =S41..V41 (Case Selection rows, were Base rows 37/43; same values with the Base case selected). Checked with the real SB2 scorer (font_color mode): new key vs itself 1.0, input plus all key fixes (formulas and colours) 1.0, untouched input 0.0, planted-only fixes (old key) 0.0 (expected).

title: Ground truth breaks the stated 3-colour convention on about 5,468 graded cells, so an agent that applies the convention throughout fails the regression gate
evidence: The prompt says the model uses one font convention: "black for in-sheet formulas with any math, green for plain cell references like =A1 or ='Sheet'!B2, and blue for hardcoded values." It exempts no sheet. I scanned all 13,281 cells in answer_position in gt_08_golden.xlsx. 5,468 non-empty cells break that convention. Hardcoded numbers in black: BS 1,539 (BS!C6 743.114), Graphs 1,310, CFS 511, IS Quarters 501, Key Stats 331, IS Annual 305, IS Quarters 2 284, ADDTL - 212, Operating Model + DCF 113 (C3 2019, C87 2025), Revenue Build 89, Comps + WACC 72 (C4 47351.38), Employees 60, Cover 5 (D7 180.65). Hardcoded values in green: 57 on Operating Model + DCF. Plain references left black: 'Operating Model + DCF'!C89 =M20, C92 =M36, C93 =M62, C94 =M84 (49 cells), and 'Comps + WACC'!C17 =F4 (10 cells). Formulas with math left green: C118, C132, C145 =C143/C144-1 in 00C800. References in a different green: 'Revenue Build'!D17:H17 in 00B050. All of these are the same in the input, so the verifier treats them as regression cells. verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (weight 1, the only check) scores 0 unless at least 99.8% of regression cells match the GT. That allows about 26 changed cells out of roughly 13,230. An agent that 'thoroughly' enforces the stated convention will recolour hundreds or thousands of these cells and get 0. The GT only fixes about 40 hand-picked cells (C4:D4, C8:H8, D41/D47/D53, C62:H62, N63:Q63, C90:H90, 'Revenue Build'!S6:V6).
confirmation: Verified that the golden keeps plain references black (C89 '=M20', C117 '=Cover!$D$7', 'Comps + WACC'!C17 '=F4') contrary to the stated green-for-references rule. These are regression cells, so applying the convention across the workbook exceeds the ~26-cell tolerance.
fix: Colour fixes: every non-empty graded cell now follows the prompt's 3-colour rule: 5,332 black and 57 green hardcoded numbers -> blue 0000FF (BS 1,539, Graphs 1,310, CFS 511, IS Quarters 501, Key Stats 331, IS Annual 305, IS Quarters 2 284, ADDTL - 212, Operating Model + DCF 170, Revenue Build 89, Comps + WACC 72, Employees 60, Cover 5), 59 black plain references (C89:H89, C92:H94, C117, 'Comps + WACC'!C17 ...) and 'Revenue Build'!D17:H17 (00B050) -> green 006600, and the math formulas C118, C132, C145 (00C800) -> black. Done at XML level (cloned font/xf entries), so all other cells, formulas and styles are unchanged. Checked with the real SB2 scorer (font_color mode): new key vs itself 1.0, input plus all key fixes (formulas and colours) 1.0, untouched input 0.0, planted-only fixes (old key) 0.0 (expected).

title: Task instructions contradict the ground truth and verifier: prompt requires fixing formula logic, broken references, and calculation errors, plus enforcing a 3-color font convention across the workbook, while the golden file leaves numerous formula/reference bugs unfixed and only updates font colors on 31 arbitrarily selected cells
evidence:
In `problem.py`, the instruction states: "Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability. The model uses a 3-color font convention: black for in-sheet formulas with any math, green for plain cell references like =A1 or ='Sheet'!B2, and blue for hardcoded values." In `spec.yaml`, `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1) compares `output.xlsx` against `gt_08_golden.xlsx` in `mode: font_color`, requiring 100% match on the 32 modification cells and >=99.8% match on the ~9,350 regression cells. However, comparing `untouched_input_Inconsistent Color Coding_input.xlsx` to `gt_08_golden.xlsx` reveals that the golden file only clears a stray `'c'` in `Operating Model + DCF!S6` and changes the font color of 31 cells (`Operating Model + DCF!C4:D4, C8:H8, D41, D47, D53, C62:H62, N63:Q63, C90:H90` and `Revenue Build!S6:V6`), while leaving actual broken cell references and calculation errors untouched AND leaving hundreds of 3-color convention violations untouched in the regression set:
1. Unfixed formula/reference bugs in GT: `Operating Model + DCF!R84` has `=R847-M83` (typo for `=R83-M83`, referencing empty row 847); `Operating Model + DCF!C36:H36` (D&A) references `'IS Annual'!C75:H75` (empty row 75, evaluating to 0); `Operating Model + DCF!I62:L62` (Capex) references `'IS Quarters'!E69:H69` (which is Depreciation Expense for Q3 24-Q2 25 instead of Q1-Q4 2025 Capex in `'Key Stats'!G21:J21`); `Operating Model + DCF!C90` has `-0.3` for 2025 Tax Rate (while `D90:H90` are `0.3`); `Revenue Build!S9:V9` and `S15:V15` reference hardcoded Base Case rows (`S37:V37`, `S43:V43`) instead of Case Selection rows (`S35:V35`, `S41:V41`).
2. Unfixed 3-color convention violations in GT regression cells: Plain cell references left black (`000000`) instead of green (`006600`), such as `Operating Model + DCF!H7` (`='IS Annual'!H6`), `T9:V9` (`=T41:V41`, whereas `N9:S9` are green), `S12:V12` (`=S47:V47`, whereas `N12:Q12` are green), `S15:V15` (`=S53:V53`, whereas `N15:Q15` are green), and `C89:H89, C92:H94` (`=M20`, `=M36`, `=M62`, `=M84`, etc.). Hardcoded numbers left green (`006600`) or black (`000000`) instead of blue (`0000FF`), such as `Operating Model + DCF!C23:E23` (`0` in green), `D11:H11, J11:L11, D14:H14, J14:L14, D17:L17, J23:L23, J30:L30, D71:H71, D74:H74, D77:H77, D80:H80` (hardcoded numbers in green), `C98:H98` (hardcoded WACC `0.0965997` in black), `Cover!D7, D11:D14` (hardcoded inputs in black), and `Revenue Build!I5:Q5, I8:Q8, I11:R11, I14:Q14, F22:H25` (hardcoded numbers in black). Also, negated cross-sheet references `Operating Model + DCF!C62:H62` (`=-'Key Stats'!C46:H46`) are changed from black to green in GT even though they contain unary negation math.
Because of this mismatch, all 3 attempts scored 0.0: every agent that followed the prompt to apply the 3-color rule consistently or fix broken formulas triggered 90 to 125 regression/modification errors.
confirmation: Diffing untouched input vs gt_08_golden.xlsx shows only font-colour changes on about 40 cells plus clearing S6 'c'. Bugs such as R84 '=R847-M83', C90 -0.3 and black plain references (C89 '=M20', Comps C17 '=F4') stay in the regression set, so a thorough audit as instructed fails the 0.998 regression
fix: Formula fixes in gt_08_golden.xlsx ('Operating Model + DCF' unless noted; 116 dependent cached values rewritten from the verifier's LibreOffice recalc): EBT row C28:V28 now =EBIT-interest-other (=C20-C23-C26 ..., was =C20-C26 dropping interest; F28 now 52.554, matching 'IS Annual' pretax income); R84 =R83-M83 (was =R847-M83); C90 tax rate 0.3 (was -0.3); I62:L62 Capex =-'Key Stats'!G21..J21 (was 'IS Quarters'!E69:H69 depreciation); 'Revenue Build'!S9:V9 =S35..V35 and S15:V15 =S41..V41 (Case Selection rows, were Base rows 37/43; same values with the Base case selected). Colour fixes: every non-empty graded cell now follows the prompt's 3-colour rule: 5,332 black and 57 green hardcoded numbers -> blue 0000FF (BS 1,539, Graphs 1,310, CFS 511, IS Quarters 501, Key Stats 331, IS Annual 305, IS Quarters 2 284, ADDTL - 212, Operating Model + DCF 170, Revenue Build 89, Comps + WACC 72, Employees 60, Cover 5), 59 black plain references (C89:H89, C92:H94, C117, 'Comps + WACC'!C17 ...) and 'Revenue Build'!D17:H17 (00B050) -> green 006600, and the math formulas C118, C132, C145 (00C800) -> black. Done at XML level (cloned font/xf entries), so all other cells, formulas and styles are unchanged. Left out of answer_position (no single defensible correction): 'Operating Model + DCF'!C36:H36 (D&A points at the empty 'IS Annual' row 75, and that sheet has no D&A line; the CFS D&A row or the IS Quarters depreciation row are both plausible sources; nothing depends on these cells) and C62:L62 (the negated cross-sheet links =-'Key Stats'!..: the prompt's rule gives black only to in-sheet math and green only to plain references, so either colour is defensible; the key turned C62:H62 green, QA says black). The Capex values still reach the grade through M62 and the DCF. Checked with the real SB2 scorer (font_color mode): new key vs itself 1.0, input plus all key fixes (formulas and colours) 1.0, untouched input 0.0, planted-only fixes (old key) 0.0 (expected).
